purpose: Evidence-backed candidate locality registry for Ahmedabad and Hyderabad student-area guides. This file does not create listings or automatically make pages indexable.

publishingRules.indexability: Area guide pages are generated with noindex,follow and excluded from XML sitemaps until a human editorial review confirms substantial unique local value, current source evidence and a useful visitor task. A locality name or institution address alone is insufficient.
publishingRules.listings: Only show live published StudentHubHelp listings returned for the exact city and locality; if none, show an honest empty state without sample cards.

candidateAreas.name: Navrangpura
candidateAreas.evidence: Ahmedabad University's official student residence address is in Navrangpura, opposite Gujarat University Metro Station; its Student Village Annexe is also in Navrangpura near Mithakhali.
candidateAreas.guideAngle: Student-area orientation around Ahmedabad University and Gujarat University; explain that accommodation availability must be checked separately.

candidateAreas.name: Vastrapur
candidateAreas.evidence: IIM Ahmedabad's official campus address is Vastrapur, Ahmedabad 380015.
candidateAreas.guideAngle: Locality guide for students whose destination is IIM Ahmedabad; do not claim nearby rentals or services without live listing evidence.

candidateAreas.name: Paldi
candidateAreas.evidence: National Institute of Design's official Ahmedabad campus is in Paldi, Ahmedabad 380007.
candidateAreas.guideAngle: Design-student orientation around NID Ahmedabad; keep accommodation and commute details factual and independently verified.

candidateAreas.name: Thaltej
candidateAreas.evidence: PRL publishes separate Main Campus (Navrangpura) and Thaltej campus information, confirming Thaltej as an institutional destination in Ahmedabad.
candidateAreas.guideAngle: Area guide for students/research visitors with a Thaltej-side destination; avoid broad claims about student housing density.

candidateAreas.name: Vaishnodevi Circle / SG Highway
candidateAreas.evidence: Nirma University's official 2026-27 student information booklet gives its address on Sarkhej-Gandhinagar Highway near Vaishnodevi Circle, Ahmedabad.
candidateAreas.guideAngle: Campus-oriented guide for Nirma University access; do not label this locality as Gota or claim travel times without verification.

candidateAreas.name: Gachibowli
candidateAreas.evidence: University of Hyderabad identifies its campus address as Prof. C. R. Rao Road, Gachibowli, Hyderabad 500046.
candidateAreas.guideAngle: University of Hyderabad destination guide; explain on-campus hostel availability from official rules rather than imply off-campus listings.

candidateAreas.name: Kukatpally
candidateAreas.evidence: Jawaharlal Nehru Technological University Hyderabad publishes its main campus address in Kukatpally, Hyderabad 500085.
candidateAreas.guideAngle: JNTUH campus-oriented guide; distinguish university-provided hostels from independent accommodation listings.

candidateAreas.name: Ameerpet & S.R. Nagar
candidateAreas.evidence: A published study on Hyderabad working-women's hostels discusses Ameerpet and S.R. Nagar together as one area cluster; this is historical context, not current student-housing supply data.
candidateAreas.guideAngle: Combined context guide for Ameerpet and S.R. Nagar. Keep the two localities together until distinct, current evidence supports separate student guides.

candidateAreas.name: Madhapur
candidateAreas.evidence: A published study identifies Madhapur as one of the Hyderabad hostel clusters; its figures are historical research context, not live supply.
candidateAreas.guideAngle: Area orientation with dated source context; require current, independently verified campus and transit references before publishing detailed advice.

candidateAreas.name: Dilsukhnagar / Malakpet
candidateAreas.evidence: A published study identifies Dilsukhnagar/Malakpet as a combined Hyderabad hostel cluster; it does not establish separate current supply for each locality.
candidateAreas.guideAngle: Keep as a combined guide unless reliable locality-specific evidence supports splitting it.

candidateAreas.name: Mehdipatnam
candidateAreas.evidence: A published study identifies Mehdipatnam as one of the Hyderabad hostel clusters; this is contextual evidence only.
candidateAreas.guideAngle: Potential locality guide subject to fresh institutional, transport and local-context verification.
